fields.name: classes
fields.label: Variant
fields.description: Home shows loan categories as chips; Product shows a category dropdown and hides the slide button on desktop; Plain hides the lead form.

fields.name: formHeading
fields.label: Form heading
fields.description: Heading and short description shown above the lead form.

fields.name: formOptions_categories
fields.label: Loan categories
fields.description: Comma-separated list. The first four are shown, the rest appear under "More". The value sent for each one can be set in Loan category identifiers below.

fields.name: formOptions_fields
fields.label: Form fields
fields.description: Comma-separated field labels, e.g. "Your name, Mobile number" or "First name, Last name". A label containing "mobile" or "phone" gets a +91 phone input. Leave the form heading and categories empty to hide the form.

fields.name: formIdentifiers
fields.label: Loan category identifiers
fields.description: Optional: the value sent to the lead service for each loan category, comma separated in the same order as Loan categories (1st identifier for the 1st category, and so on), e.g. "NC, UC, , CL". A category without one is sent as its text. Identifiers set on the form's own category dropdown take precedence.

fields.name: formAction
fields.label: Form submit URL
fields.description: Endpoint that receives the lead (name, mobile, category). Leave empty to show a confirmation message only.

fields.name: categoryForms
fields.label: Category forms
fields.description: Optional: one form (modal page) per category, in the same order as the categories: the 1st page opens for the 1st category, the 2nd for the 2nd, and so on. Use the Form submit URL page for a category that has no form of its own. Categories beyond the last page open the Form submit URL.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Heading, short description and a bold link for the call to action. A bulleted list of "Label: value" items becomes stat badges.
